Card Q&A.q: Does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect gain me 1 memory per each of my opponent's Tamers?

Card Q&A.a: Yes. You’ll gain 1 memory for each of your opponent’s Tamers.
Card Q&A.q: If my opponent has multiple Tamers but only 1 Digimon in play, do I gain 1 memory for each of my opponent's Tamers even though only 1 Digimon will be suspended?

Card Q&A.a: Yes. The effect reads, “You may delete that Digimon,” so you can choose not to. If you choose not to, the effect’s [Once Per Turn] requirement won’t be used up, either.
Card Q&A.q: If my opponent’s Digimon with 6000 DP or less becomes suspended, can I choose NOT to delete it with this card’s [All Turns] effect?

Card Q&A.a: When your opponent activates , the target of the attack is switched to the Digimon that activated , and that Digimon is then deleted by this Digimon's [All Turns] effect. Since the Digimon that activated  was deleted, no battle occurs, and the attack ends.
Card Q&A.q: I attack with a Digimon, and my opponent activates  to suspend their Digimon with 6000 DP or less. I then activate this card’s [All Turns] effect to delete that Digimon. What happens to the attack?

Yes you can, as long as they are simultaneously suspended.
